fields.options:
An Inter Branch Sale moves stock to another group entity that keeps its own books, at a selling price, without a Sales Invoice (nothing is reported to ZATCA). On submit it posts a Stock Entry (stock out at cost) and a Journal Entry: receivable from the customer at the selling price, the cost cleared, and the difference to the margin account.

Nothing can be submitted until every account below is set and the customer is in the list. The accounts are the client's accountant's decision. The margin account is an internal recharge, not turnover: exclude it from any revenue report.

fields.label: Receivable Account
fields.description: A Receivable account (Debtors). The customer is posted as its party, so the amount shows in that customer's statement and ageing.

fields.label: Inter-Branch Clearing Account
fields.description: Balance Sheet account the Stock Entry debits when the stock leaves. The Journal Entry clears it to zero, so it should always read nil.

fields.label: Inter-Branch Margin Account
fields.description: Income account for selling price minus cost. Not turnover.

fields.label: Default Price List
fields.description: Selling price list read when an item has no rate typed in.

fields.label: Customers Allowed For Inter Branch Sales
fields.description: Only these customers can be used. Create each one as a normal Customer (tick Is Internal Customer) first.
